meta.name: debug
meta.description: Debug container agent issues. Use when things aren't working, container fails, authentication problems, or to understand how the container system works. Covers logs, session DBs, mounts, and common issues.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 排查容器和 agent 运行问题
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常遇到容器或 agent 运行异常需要定位根因
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to diagnose container or agent runtime problems

howto.what: 装上此技能后,当容器代理出故障时,Claude 会按调试手册指导你逐步排查:查看日志、检查数据库、核对挂载等,并给出诊断与修复建议。
howto.when: 当容器代理运行异常、认证出错,或你想了解容器系统工作原理时触发。

say.text: 容器代理没反应,帮我查日志和会话数据库。
say.note: Claude 会指引你查看错误日志和进出数据库。

say.text: 容器启动失败,查一下认证和挂载。
say.note: Claude 会检查网关和挂载配置。

say.text: 帮我跑一遍快速诊断脚本,看环境是否正常。
say.note: Claude 会依次检查 Docker、镜像、网关等。

howto.what_en: When enabled, Claude guides you through the NanoClaw debugging manual: check logs, query session DBs, verify mounts, and more, with step-by-step diagnosis and fixes.
howto.when_en: Triggers when container agent misbehaves, authentication errors occur, or you want to understand how the container system works.

say_en.text: My container agent is not responding; help me check logs and session DBs.
say_en.note: Claude guides you through error log and session DB checks.

say_en.text: The container exits on start; check auth and mounts.
say_en.note: Claude walks you through gateway and mount config.

say_en.text: Run the quick diagnostic script to verify the environment.
say_en.note: Claude steps through Docker, image, gateway, and more.
